title: Regenerate Xcode project with xcodegen
description: Run 'xcodegen generate' in the project root after all new Swift source files are in place. Verify the new CookbookApp/Recipes/ group and FolderSetupView.swift appear in the generated .xcodeproj. If project.yml requires an explicit source glob or group entry for the new Recipes/ subdirectory, update it first. Confirm xcodebuild can compile after regeneration.
acceptance_criteria: CookbookApp/Recipes/ source group is present in the generated project
FolderSetupView.swift is included in the generated project
New test files in CookbookAppTests/ are included
xcodebuild build (or xcodebuild test) succeeds after regeneration
